Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

Lines the skin with retro-reflective nanoprojectors that makes the user impossible to locate in visible spectrum light. Not as effective as what Militech ‘borgs bring to the field, but useful against gangers.

External Body Cyberware. Requires 2 Option Slots. When activated with an Action, the user becomes invisible for the next 1 minute (20 Rounds), until an Attack or Run Action is made by the user, or until the user is hit by an Attack. While invisible, the user can make Stealth Checks without an Action against enemies even while within line of sight, with all Perception Checks against them made at a -4 penalty. Enemies cannot target the user unless they succeed on a Perception Check against the user’s contested Stealth. This cyberware has a 10 minute cooldown to charge before it can be activated again.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 2

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
